notes.title: Localization + Zooming + Halloween Update! 🎃
notes.notes:
Dear Horticulturists,

'Tis the spooky season where the leaves are falling from the trees and pumpkin-spiced lattes are served in the cafés of Undermere. In this update, your little shop of horrors has been kitted out with some spooky accoutrements to get you in the Halloween vibe. We've also added Polish, Portuguese, Czech, and Turkish localization!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/f0cea92215702fa651541566fcf1c2a42108b201.png

Halloween!
For a limited time, you'll see a new loading screen and some cute pumpkins to fiddle around with. How will you use them to spruce up the shoppe? Color code with orange plants? Strewn about the shelves randomly? 

https://i.imgur.com/d9J9hCu.gif

With Halloween come black cats, so we've added one to the shop! Its name is Hellebo-- oh, right... Hellebore was always there. Still, give 'em some extra scritches around Halloween.

https://i.imgur.com/oypU2Vd.gif

Zooming QoL change
Additionally, we've added a new zoom feature with this update. While playing, simply press and hold the SHIFT key to instantly take out your trusty magnifying glass and zoom in on whatever you're looking at. This will make it easier to quickly read small texts.

https://i.imgur.com/IY32YtN.gif

Localization
It's not just pumpkins and black kitties — we've also added four new languages to Strange Horticulture! Polish, Portuguese, Czech, and Turkish localization are all available now, with Dutch localization also coming soon™. Achievements have been localized as well, so you can properly tell what achievement you've unlocked.

Have a wonderful spooky season, and enjoy the update 🎃

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/52c74756fd523c82e8c4f7896a91cc9b5f8e21a2.png

notes.title: Update: More Shelf Space, Identified Plant Tick Marks, And Fixes!
notes.notes:
Dear Horticulturists,

We've been listening to your feedback and have added a couple of features that several of you have requested. Perhaps most excitingly: identified plants will now be marked with a tick! There's now also more shelf space for Wandering Bue to wander across.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/7af87110a4605281909d8769e908a2adb574f39b.png

Changelog:

 Added tick marks to the plant book for identified plants
 Extended the shelving area to give you a bit more room for your plants
 Fixed an issue where a hint wasn't displaying correctly on day 8
 A few other small fixes and improvements

notes.title: Update: Ultrawide Monitors Fix, Plant Color Tweaks, And More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's our first official update! We've got some small but important fixes and tweaks in this one, such as a fix for ultrawide monitors, and some plant color tweaks.

Fixes

 Fixed an issue where it was possible to miss out on rewards if you changed language while on a map event.
 Fixed an issue with the hint for the Arnside Antiquities card not showing up.
 Fixed an issue where the ‘Create Elixir’ button showed up over the map event buttons.
 Fixed an issue with zoomed in camera scrolling – it now scrolls better when on the zoomed in map for example.
 Fixed an issue where it was possible to get stuck if you visited the ritual site in the post-game section.
 Fixed a minor display issue where the button for successful identification of a plant said ‘Collect’ when there were no rewards instead of just ‘OK’.
 Fixed an issue where inputs weren’t working properly when you had a controller plugged in.
 Attempted a fix for an issue where rewards aren’t collectable for some reason - this is a tricky one though and we still aren’t certain what is causing it.
 Fixed a few issues with translated text resulting in inaccurate clues.
 Fixed a minor issue where it appeared that Lesser Merrydock or Lisle of Neptune could be received twice.
 Fixed issue where it was impossible to complete the game over puzzles on an ultra wide monitor.
 Fixed an issue where it was possible to be locked out from collecting the Henchuck plant.


Gameplay adjustments

 Tweaked the sizes of the Use Plant and Leave buttons to help mitigate misclicks.
 Tweaked description and colour of Solomon’s Sceptre plant to help with identification.
 Adjusted the colour of Haverage to make sure it is more blue.


There are some more gameplay adjustments below, but they may include story spoilers, or spoilers for items received a little later into the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/b8e4d30d0c77995fb4dc4b32a21cadb49c8942d8.png

Gameplay adjustments - POSSIBLE SPOILERS

 Improved visibility of the mushroom guide in the lab.
 Slight adjustment to Norwood plant to make it a bit more noticeable under the magic viewer.
 Added an extra leaf to the Mountain Astory plant to avoid it being confused as a five-pointed leaf when brewing St Quentin’s Elixir.
 Changed the ‘First letter of Truthsayer’ clue card to use the Latin name instead so that it will work in different languages. Also changed the plant to Goldenlight to improve the clue.
 Fixed the alignment on the ritual text in the circular box.
 Added a tick to the magic viewer note once the viewer has been activated.


That's it for today's patch! Let us know if you've found another pesky bug on the Steam forums, or on Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/52c74756fd523c82e8c4f7896a91cc9b5f8e21a2.png

notes.title: Demo Update: Watering Can, Colored Labels, And Zoom!
notes.notes:
Dear Horticulturists,

With Autumn in full swing, we felt like it was the perfect time for some of the cozy vibes Strange Horticulture has to offer. That's why we've updated the demo for your plant-identifying pleasure. Here's what's new in the updated demo:


  Watering can that allows you to water your plants to earn Will to Explore rather than having to wait for the cooldown.
  Coloured labels for extra organising.
  Zoom in/out feature for players who were struggling to read.
  Language support for German, Russian and Chinese.
  A whole bunch of other small fixes and improvements.


Can't run a proper plant shop without a watering can. You can now give your lovely plants the H2O they deserve, while earning you Will to Explore -- it's a win-win!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/bcf88b4495d6b028605125f801cee1b2d22eb632.gif

Colored labels will allow you to properly sort plants into categories. How are you going to use them?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/855f6bfd59571491e34ab7e24ef36c0ecbe2703a.gif

Try out the update for yourself, and let us know what you think!

notes.title: NEW Trailer + Steam Next Fest Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Dear Horticulturists,

We're happy to see that many of you have been enjoying our demo so far. We've been tinkering away at the game, and have some exciting new things to share.

First, a proper introduction to Undermere and the story of Strange Horticulture through an all-new trailer! What does the Horticulturist do exactly, and what is happening in and around Undermere?

[previewyoutube=v69Jp10nLK8;full][/previewyoutube]

Proper spooky. We hope you enjoyed that as much as we do!

Steam Next Fest - Demo Update
And that's not all. We've updated our demo with some features and tweaks that were suggested by those of you who gave the previous demo a try.

Changelog


 More clues to find the correct plants early on, making it easier to identify them.
 Added an intro page to the encyclopedia to explain what it is and how it should be used.
 Reworked the 'game over' state. The day no longer fully resets upon getting 3 plants wrong. Instead, you will be given a simple puzzle to solve, after which you'll be back to your last checkpoint.
 Added more hints. For example, if you haven't explored yet by the time you need a certain plant, a hint will pop up.
 You can now drag labels to the plants as well as the other way around.
 You can now enable auto-labeling in the settings. This will label any plant you've identified.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047389/68af46a514368fb05251acddb30f16f8655b7e6d.gif

There were a few more small changes, but these are the highlights. Thank you for all of your feedback, it's been invaluable!

Also, keep your eye on our store page if you're interested in a little panel where we chat about the game for about an hour -- it's worth the watch!

And of course, if you have any more feedback, feel free to post it on the Steam forums, or join us on Discord!
